response.original_title: SENJO 20th Anniversary TOUR in 新宿ＦＡＣＥ　～Burning　UP！～
response.overview: SENJO 20th Anniversary Tour in Shinjuku FACE ~Burning Up!~ was a professional wrestling event promoted by Sendai Girls' Pro-Wrestling, held on September 23, 2026 at Shinjuku FACE in Tokyo, Japan. It was the last Senjo event held at the venue before its closure on September 30, 2026.
